title: Write a reader-facing rationale for memory-bench maintainers, including the benchmark origin against its author own system
notes: be read.** The two-track argument, the saturation explanation, the untuned
floor and the threshold-preregistration rule are all in
`docs/superpowers/specs/`, addressed to the agent that implemented them.
Restating them for a maintainer of a system being measured is what makes the
fairness assumptions inspectable — and that restatement must carry the
inconvenient parts forward, including this benchmark's origin as a comparison
against its author's own system, or the reframing becomes reputation

2026-11-24 audit: owner decided 2026-10-11 the draft is kept, not published. docs/spec/revision-1.md (normative rules, D4 saturation, D5 untuned floor) and README cover part of the rationale, but no file states the benchmark origin as a comparison against the author own system (grep for author/atrium/own system finds nothing relevant); two-track argument still only in docs/superpowers/specs/. Left: owner decides whether to publish a maintainer-facing rationale that carries the origin disclosure; if yes, write it in docs/. No work now.
